propositions: Quickstart examples in README.md and docs/user-guide.md teach bare handle `--assignee alice` which is Jira-unresolvable; correct examples should omit `--assignee` (to apply `ticket.default_assignee`) or use email form `--assignee=alice@example.com`.
docs/README.md:25 routes MCP documentation to `llm-framework.md` instead of the authoritative `docs/mcp-reference.md`.
docs/README.md:91 describes `config.md` as covering removed `.rebar/config.conf` flat keys; should describe `rebar.toml` / `[tool.rebar]` pyproject table instead.
pyproject.toml:488-490 header comment states non-core tree mypy is checked advisory-only, but CI gates mypy over whole library and scripts/ (contradicting Makefile:248 and _build-and-test.yml)

Bare handle examples in both README.md:50 (library block `rebar.claim(tid, assignee="alice")`) and docs/user-guide.md:234 (`rebar edit` with `--assignee=bob`) teach unresolvable identities; must use Jira-resolvable form or omit per default behavior.
